title: AI Suggestions
subtitle: Let Claude suggest recipes from what you have (and a short shopping list).
maxToBuyHint: 0 means suggestions must only use what you already have.
notConfiguredBody: Recipe suggestions need an Anthropic API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) on the backend. Once it's added, come back and try again — the rest of the app works without it.
emptyResult: No suggestions came back. Try allowing a few more ingredients to buy, or switch to using all your ingredients.
